title: Kaiser's Golden apples
description: This is my first texture pack pls wish me luck on the next one
body:
Hello there! This is my first texture pack i made and published so far. Im planning for more and if you can give me ideas what i can do next would be nice. This texture pack works from 1.21.11+
so you can play on your lates version also. 
Have a good time playing with this texture pack!
